# Generated by lvglpp ports/esp32/adapters/smart_speaker/sync_to_smart_speaker.sh
# Drop this file at smart-speaker/components/lvglpp/CMakeLists.txt.
#
# Uses the project's managed lvgl/lvgl component. Do NOT add sdk/lvgl or
# LV_CONF_PATH here; the project's Kconfig is authoritative.

set(LVGLPP_SDK "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/sdk")

file(GLOB_RECURSE LVGLPP_SOURCES
    "${LVGLPP_SDK}/core/base/*.cpp"
    "${LVGLPP_SDK}/core/widgets/*.cpp"
    "${LVGLPP_SDK}/core/style/*.cpp"
    "${LVGLPP_SDK}/core/sys/*.cpp"
    "${LVGLPP_SDK}/core/tools/*.cpp"
)

list(APPEND LVGLPP_SOURCES
    "${LVGLPP_SDK}/config/color_sheet.cpp"
    "${LVGLPP_SDK}/core/sys/platform/PlatformFactory.cpp"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/ports/esp32/EspPlatform.cpp"
)

# Desktop-only backends and optional subsystems not used by ESP-IDF.
list(FILTER LVGLPP_SOURCES EXCLUDE REGEX "/core/sys/platform/(Sdl|Framebuf|Drm)Platform\\.cpp$")
list(FILTER LVGLPP_SOURCES EXCLUDE REGEX "/core/sys/platform/EvdevInput\\.cpp$")
list(FILTER LVGLPP_SOURCES EXCLUDE REGEX "/core/sys/automation/")
list(FILTER LVGLPP_SOURCES EXCLUDE REGEX "/core/log/log\\.cpp$")


idf_component_register(
    SRCS ${LVGLPP_SOURCES}
    INCLUDE_DIRS
        "${LVGLPP_SDK}"
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/ports/esp32/include"
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/ports/esp32"
    REQUIRES
        lvgl
        esp_timer
)

target_compile_definitions(${COMPONENT_LIB} PUBLIC
    LVGLPP_PLATFORM_ESP32=1
)

# Keep third-party/stb warnings non-fatal under IDF's global -Werror. They are
# still printed; fixes should go upstream rather than being hidden.
target_compile_options(${COMPONENT_LIB} PRIVATE -Wno-error)
